a.xlink:title: Adds a widget to the flow layout within the FlowWidget.
Adds a new item to the layout.
Retrieves the count of items in the layout.
Reports which axis the layout can expand along.
Height-for-width is only meaningful for horizontal (wrapping) flow.
Returns the height required to display all items within width.
Returns the layout item at the specified index.
Removes and returns the item at the specified index.
Emitted when the display type (flat or overlapping layout) changes.
Emitted when a new grouping criterion is selected.
Emitted when the order of sort criteria changes.
Converts a CardRef into an ExactCard.
Updates all UI text for retranslation/localization.
Slot triggered whenever the sort list is reordered.
Toggles the display layout between flat and overlapping modes.
